title: dam rm answer for a token
description: What dam rm prints with --json or --toon when a token takes a task or event back by --id, oid or hash, and when dam rm --id finds nothing. withdrawn: the item it sent was still waiting and is gone; for a new item, oid equals item. waiting: a removal item waits for the owner; a repeat names the same item. declined: the owner declined that removal and it is not sent again. nothing: nothing of the caller's is there under that id.

item.description: The item withdrawn, or the removal item.

oid.description: The task or event. Equals item for a withdrawn new item.
